game.name: derks-gym
game.description: Derk's Gym: PufferLib's Ocean MOBA with a pre-match loadout draft. Six seats, three per team, one hero each (the other four heroes are driven in-process by the vendored pretrained network); before tick 0 all six seats simultaneously and blindly pick one ARM, one TAIL and one MISC item from a 12-item catalog, and the summed, clamped stat deltas are written into the heroes for the whole match. Then it is the upstream 5v5 MOBA, bit-exact with the training environment: the same C sim compiled to wasm, the same 510-byte observations and [7,7,3,2,2,2] MultiDiscrete actions, creep waves down three lanes, 24 towers and two 4500-HP Ancients. The match is won by destroying the enemy Ancient, or at the tick cap by remaining Ancient health. The policy is metagame plus micro: the draft is one decision that shapes 6000 ticks. Replays re-simulate deterministically in a static wasm viewer from the recorded seed, loadouts and per-tick action log.

seed.description: Deterministic sim seed. Omitted: the server derives a fresh random seed and records it in results and the replay header.

tokens.description: One connection token per player seat, indexed by seat slot. Injected by the runner; never authored.

players.description: One player display-name object per seat, indexed by seat slot. Exactly six: each seat plays one hero (pids 0, 1, 2, 5, 6, 7); the other four heroes are driven in-process by the vendored pretrained network on the neutral loadout.

max_ticks.description: Tick cap; reaching it ends the episode with an Ancient-health tiebreak.

num_agents.description: Number of agent seats; must equal the player slot count. Used by the platform ladder service for block seating.

draft_enabled.description: True: one simultaneous hidden draft turn before tick 0, and the summed post-clamp stat blocks are applied to the sim. False: the Puffer-fidelity mode — no draft turn and no loadout applied at all, so the sim is byte-identical to the upstream PufferLib Ocean MOBA.

catalog_version.description: Loadout catalog version, pinned so a future catalog cannot silently re-interpret an old replay. v1 is 3 slots x 4 items; its canonical sha256 (catalog + clamp table) is 7c80ff58b617e148de4bfddfbfcaf8c336512123de6bfd582351de35ccefaef7 — see docs/DRAFT.md.

tick_deadline_ms.description: Per-tick action deadline in milliseconds; a late/missing/malformed reply plays the no-op action for that seat's hero.

draft_deadline_ms.description: The single draft turn's shared wall-clock deadline; all six seats are asked as one parallel batch under it.

wall_clock_budget_seconds.description: Engine wall-clock hard stop, timed from the start of the draft turn: a slow episode ends itself with end_reason wall_clock (Ancient-health tiebreak, artifacts written). Sized so connect 60 s + draft 45 s + play 600 s = 705 s stays inside 60% of the 1200 s platform episode budget.

player_connect_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for all six seats to connect before the draft turn; seats that never connect play the neutral loadout plus no-op and are reported to COGAME_PLAYER_FAILURE_URI.

seed.description: The deterministic sim seed the episode ran with.

team.description: One team name per seat (server-assigned: seats 0-2 radiant, 3-5 dire).

note.description: The seat's free-text note, truncated to 120 Unicode scalars.

seat.description: Seat slot that drafted it, or null for a house hero.

picks.description: One catalog item id per slot.

applied.description: The absolute post-clamp stat block written into the sim.

fallback.description: True when the server substituted the neutral loadout.

decision_ms.description: Wall-clock ms the seat took to answer the draft turn.

player_name.description: The real policy name, or null for a house hero.

fallback_cause.description: Why the neutral loadout was substituted (none = it was not).

draft.description: The ten draft-reveal records in pid order: picks, note, source, fallback cause and the applied stat block for every hero.

names.description: One player name per seat, in seat-slot order.

scores.description: One scalar score per seat: win 1.0, draw 0.5, loss 0.0. Higher is better; the array sums to 3.0.

winner.description: Winning team: 0 radiant, 1 dire, null draw.

dead_seats.description: Per-seat strike-rule dead flag at episode end (10 consecutive missed ticks marks a seat dead; a valid reply revives it).

end_reason.description: Why the episode ended: an Ancient fell, the tick cap was reached, the engine's wall-clock budget expired (tick_cap and wall_clock share the Ancient-health tiebreak), or the sim reported an internal fault (sim_fault: no winner, draw scores, partial replay). A draft failure is never fatal — it degrades to the neutral loadout.

noop_ticks.description: Per-seat count of ticks played as the no-op fallback (late, missing, malformed, or dead seat).

agent_stats.description: Per-hero end-of-episode stats, indexed by hero pid (0-4 radiant, 5-9 dire) — all ten heroes, seats and house heroes alike.

noop_causes.description: Per-seat NOOP-fallback cause counters. timeout/malformed/disconnected/host_error partition noop_ticks; wrong_tick counts mis-addressed reply messages at the transport.

reward_sums.description: Per-seat sum of the sim's per-hero training rewards (observability only, never ranked).

ancient_healths.description: Remaining Ancient health at episode end: [radiant, dire].

draft_fallbacks.description: One boolean per seat: true when the server substituted the neutral loadout for it.

player.name: baseline
player.description: puffer-forge: a deterministic draft rule (one fixed item set per role) plus the upstream PufferLib pretrained policy (moba_weights.bin through the vendored puffernet compiled to wasm) for the per-tick micro. The certification fixture player and the image's default.

player.name: lane-brawler
player.description: lane-brawler: a draft rule derived from the observed base stats plus the hand-coded finite-state lane-push bot for the micro (no pretrained weights).

player.name: drafter
player.description: derk-drafter-v1: one Anthropic call decides the loadout before tick 0, then the vendored pretrained network plays every tick. With no API key it falls back to the puffer-forge draft rule and still plays a legal, complete episode.

variants.name: Draft (3v3)
variants.description: Six seats, one hero each, three per team. Each seat drafts one arm, one tail and one misc item before tick 0; the two remaining heroes per team run the vendored pretrained network on the neutral loadout.

variants.name: No draft (Puffer fidelity)
variants.description: The same 3v3 seating with the draft turn disabled: no loadout is applied, so the sim is byte-identical to the upstream PufferLib Ocean MOBA the pretrained policies were trained on.
